comment: The panel prints DR and SR where the maker's tooltips say 1st Decay Rate and 2nd Decay Rate. The six envelope sliders read higher as slower, because the code subtracts the slider from the register maximum before writing it to the chip. MUL, FB, LFO, FMS, AMS, Loop and Rate Scale have no CV input.
